entries.description: A small tidy-up inside the app. Nothing looks different

changelog.title: Improved
items: Removed leftover code the app no longer uses

entries.description: Large display size keeps the full screen and bottom navigation visible

changelog.title: Fixed
items: Large display size no longer cuts off the right edge or bottom navigation on affected phones

entries.description: The player follows your finger, replayed songs use less data, and Stream has a clearer header

changelog.title: New
items: Songs you stream are kept temporarily on your phone, so replaying them can use less data. Choose the space limit in Settings, Playback
The app tries to resume songs interrupted by a dropped connection
Use your own AI key on the website to translate lyrics or read their pronunciation

changelog.title: Improved
items: The player follows your finger up and down, at any speed, and closes onto one mini player
Stream has your picture at the top left, with Devices and the LuvLyrics logo together at the top right
Songs and Playlists in Stream switch with one neat control
The app finds new versions reliably, so updates show up in About

entries.description: New versions show up in About again, and every change from 1.68.0 and 1.68.1 is in this build

changelog.title: New
items: Connect ListenBrainz in Settings to keep a copy of what you listen to on your own profile
Your full history stays on this phone, and nothing is sent until you connect

changelog.title: Improved
items: The app finds new versions reliably, so updates show up in About
Search tells you when the catalog cannot be reached, with a Try again button
The close button on the info card works
Small buttons are easier to tap, including the info buttons and filter chips
Text in Search and the Now Playing controls no longer gets cut off at larger sizes
